claims.uniform_operator: For odd numerator degree m=2h+1, h>=2, normalized affine canonical trace theta=s+t*rho gives D=2(L+k_h*R)q^2. For t!=-2 this is equivalent to the explicit linear polynomial operator kernel.
claims.generic_accessory_curve: Away from the diagonal zeros, the unique monic kernel is obtained by triangular recurrence; its coefficients have the stated s-degree bounds, and N(1)=0 is one nonzero accessory equation of s-degree at most 2h.
claims.complete_good_open: The written converse and listed discriminant/norm conditions are equivalent to good normalized affine-trace paired pencils, including canonical sign and rational coefficient descent.
claims.degree_ten_and_twenty_six: Every rational good model in these affine-trace slices lies in the triangular chart: arbitrary rational denominator analysis and exhaustive signed-divisor evaluations leave only slope -2, which is excluded uniformly over characteristic zero.
claims.degree_twenty_six_nonempty_good_open: The exact good F29 point has a simple accessory root and all nondegeneracy units. Hensel lifting gives a Q29 point and an algebraic number-field point of degree at most twelve, with regular A26 monodromy. No Q-rational point is established.

external_sources.author: Gareth A. Jones
external_sources.title: Characteristically simple Beauville groups, I: cartesian powers of alternating groups
external_sources.statement: A primitive permutation group of degree at least nine containing a double transposition contains the alternating group.
external_sources.application: The infinity cycle fixes one sheet and moves all others, forcing primitivity; finite paired simple critical points give double transpositions. All branch cycles are even, so the geometric group is the full alternating group.
external_sources.limits: Exact proposition and its degree hypothesis were inspected. This classification input is imported, not reproved by the finite checker.

external_sources.author: James S. Milne
external_sources.title: Algebraic Number Theory
external_sources.statement: A simple residue root of an integral polynomial over a complete discretely valued field lifts uniquely to an integral root.
external_sources.application: At t=2, the accessory has a simple root s=22 modulo 29 and every good-open test is a unit. The lifted algebraic root yields a good Q29 point and a number-field point embedded in Q29.
external_sources.limits: The exact primary proposition was read. Hensel lifting gives a local or algebraic point, not a rational Q point.

scope_limits: No rational Q point or global rational-point obstruction for the degree26 good accessory curve is established.
The degree26 positive result is a local Q29 family point and a number-field point of degree at most twelve; it is not rational descent to Q.
The unique monic-kernel construction is generic in the slope. Complete rational exceptional-slope analysis is proved only for h2 and h6, not every h.
The h2 affine-trace curve covers nonconstant canonical scale. Scalar canonical scale is a separate boundary; constant paired product is not synonymous with scalar signed scale.
The normalized u0=1 chart need not be reached from an arbitrary rational z-coordinate by a rational rescaling without a square-root twist.
Finite symbolic controls do not prove all-h claims by sampling; uniformity comes from the written polynomial identity and recurrence arguments.
The model is the even-in-z Laurent slice N(z^2)/z with odd-degree N, not every polynomial pencil of degree26.
Full geometric alternating monodromy imports Jones's stated primitive-group theorem. Arithmetic regularity requires the displayed leading square class to vanish over the base field.
No rational parametrization, global priority claim, polynomial Keller realization or Jacobian-conjecture consequence is asserted.
